info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Returns-v4-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Returns API provides a streamlined approach to retrieve information regarding customer return requests for retail orders. This endpoint allows clients to access detailed data about return transactions, including order identifiers, customer details, and return status. It is commonly utilized by e-commerce platforms, customer service teams, and inventory management systems to efficiently track and manage return processes. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their customer service and improve return handling workflows.

get.description: Fetch the details of returns associated with customer orders. This endpoint allows you to access the information about returned items, their statuses, and any associated notes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for returning an order. The provided JSON must adhere to the defined schema for successful processing.

200.description: Returns a list of processed return orders.

ListRetailOrdersReturnsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for operations related to retrieving order returns via a GET request. The body should be a string in a specified format.

status.description: Indicates the success of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order return.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the return operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional details about the operation.

ListRetailOrdersReturnsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on orders return.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the order return operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
